name: Forge kernel
purpose: Decide the next build phase of a Hologram Forge app, and whether an origin may use an effect. Send phase and event separated by a space, and it answers drafting, checked, proving, proved or published. Send gate, then origin, effect, whether a grant record exists, whether it grants and whether it denies, and it answers allow or deny. Anything else gets invalid request.
inputLabel: Request: phase event, or gate origin effect record granted denied

promise.headline: Never says proved without an attestation, and never lets a preview reach the network without a grant.
promise.detail: The build phase moves to proved only on an attestation, and to published only from proved. The capability gate denies by default, a denial always wins, and a preview or published app needs an explicit grant for every effect.

claim: FK-01: the app never answers proved when phase is not proved and event is not attest. FK-02: the app never answers published when phase is not proved and phase is not published. FK-03: the app always answers drafting when event is edit. FK-04: the app never answers proving when phase is drafting. FK-05: the gate never admits an origin other than Forge when no grant record exists. FK-06: the gate never admits a fetch when no grant record exists. FK-07: the gate never admits a resource its grant record denies. FK-08: the gate never admits a preview or a published app without a grant. FK-09: the gate never lets a preview fetch without a grant.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  event is edit → drafting
  event is check and phase is drafting → checked
  event is approve and phase is checked → proving
  event is attest and phase is proving → proved
  event is fail and phase is proving → checked
  event is publish and phase is proved → published
  phase is drafting → drafting
  phase is checked → checked
  phase is proving → proving
  phase is proved → proved
  otherwise → published
proposition.plain: Decide the next build phase of a Hologram Forge app from its current phase and the event that just happened.
